findings.motion: Veto Override, Roll Call #596 (Senate Bill 747, Elections Law Changes)
findings.note: House roll call on overriding the Governor's veto of SB 747 (passed 72 to 44). The roll call lists von Haefen among the Noes. findings.motion: Second Reading, Roll Call #758 (House Bill 958, Election Law Changes)
findings.note: House second-reading vote on HB 958, a broad elections bill. The roll call lists von Haefen among the Noes. The bill text (Eighth Edition) includes a requirement that a voter registration application affirmatively state US citizenship, a sworn citizenship statement when the answer is blank, citizenship questions at drivers license offices, and a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database.
